audit_notes: The candidate maintains strict adherence to the provided documents and cutoff date.
cause_evidence: The candidate accurately extracts and synthesizes the investment thesis from the provided documents.

drivers.candidate_quote: Universal Music Group is the dominant global leader in music, boasting an extensive, high-quality catalog and a capital-light business model that serves as a royalty-like engine for the digital age
drivers.document_quote: Universal Music Group is a leading global recorded-music and music-publishing business within Vivendi. Its economics derive from developing artists, owning/licensing recordings and compositions, and monetizing consumption across physical, digital, performance and other channels.
drivers.gold_driver: Leading global music-rights/catalog platform acts as a royalty on growing consumption.
drivers.reason: The candidate accurately captures the platform's role as a rights holder that monetizes consumption.

drivers.candidate_quote: With 443 million paid subscribers globally at the end of 2020, UMG is uniquely positioned to benefit from the ongoing expansion of the music ecosystem
drivers.document_quote: IFPI reports 443 million users of paid subscription accounts at the end of 2020, with subscription streaming revenue up 18.5%. Penetration and improved monetization can expand the industry
drivers.gold_driver: Paid streaming penetration and improved monetization offer a long runway.
drivers.reason: The candidate correctly links the subscriber base and industry expansion to the growth runway.

drivers.candidate_quote: The business operates a high-margin, capital-light model that acts as a global royalty stream, directly benefiting from the secular growth of music streaming
drivers.document_quote: Existing catalogs can be licensed repeatedly without manufacturing a new physical product for every listen. That provides attractive incremental economics.
drivers.gold_driver: Repeat licensing, scale and operating leverage support capital-light cash growth.
drivers.reason: The candidate recognizes the repeat-licensing economics inherent in the capital-light catalog model.

drivers.candidate_quote: Management, led by Lucian Grainge, has demonstrated a strong record of scaling the business and navigating the transition to digital
drivers.document_quote: Lucian Grainge leads UMG. The recorded-music platform includes prominent artists and a deep catalog
drivers.gold_driver: Lucian Grainge and patient ownership align with long-duration compounding.
drivers.reason: The candidate correctly attributes the business's scaling success to Grainge's leadership.

drivers.candidate_quote: The pending spin-off is the catalyst required to unlock this value, as it will eliminate the parent company overhang and alleviate technical selling pressure
drivers.document_quote: Vivendi proposes distributing 60% of the equity and listing the company in Amsterdam by September 27 at the latest
drivers.gold_driver: Negotiated pre-listing ownership and separation can unlock independent valuation.
drivers.reason: The candidate identifies the separation catalyst as the mechanism for unlocking value.

audit_validation.policy: Exact quote failure receives zero for that endpoint; raw judge judgment retained above.
